title: Wonderful experience!
text: Alex was a wonderful guide and made the whole evening feel very personal. We learned a lot about Barcelona while enjoying some fantastic food and wine. The black rice was probably my favorite dish of the night.
author: Z4584ZXsaraf

title: Best experience!
text: Camillo had a good way of explaining things without making it feel like a tour. It felt more like walking around with someone who knows the area really well and wants to show you his favourite spots.
author: T8915HWmayac

title: Delicious and memorable
text: While in Barcelona I wanted to go on a Tapas tour. The market is saturated with these outings but I found my choice with this route and company to be exactly what I was looking for. I appreciated the quick history lesson that immerses you more into the culture. The locations were intimate and made for a great discovery of Barcelona’s Born district. You are given exclusive access to distinctly neighborhood spots where you feel like a local. You can even carrying on with other participants to enjoy more places on your own. title: Born, food and guided tour
text: Great neighborhood of Barcelona, beautiful local taverns/restaurants and a must do in Barcelona. We highly recommend it. Congrats and see you soon!

title: 3 tours done, this one the best local food experience!
text: Wooooow tour with great food, loved it! Will book a second tour from them as I got really impressed by the authentic local experience. Congrats and well done, hope to see you soon again.

title: Great Local experience
text: I was extremly surprised by the great local food, a super helpful guide and the great atmosphere we had in pur small group tour and in that beutiful neighborhood. We will repeat for sure with Go for a Journey.
